decoder.buildStatus: inferred schema version; not independently verified game client build

schema.match: same schema text; exported decoder checkout uses CRLF

policy.semantics: Pinned decoder schema reads opcode 0x10 as true; absent opcode defaults false. Raw booleans crosschecked against the projected export. No numeric param is used.
policy.templates: Exclude all note, loan, bind and combine template definitions, including old opcode forms.
policy.matching: NFC plus legacy text decoding; exact name first; casefold only for one exact name. Markup and trailing picker markers belong to the caller.
policy.conflicts: Cache name conflicts are unknown unless pinned Infobox Item literal IDs match that exact cache name, every selected ID has an explicit consistent Wiki membership field, and the cache flags agree. Wiki IDs narrow identity; other candidate IDs remain recorded.
limits: Membership of an item is distinct from membership or availability of each acquisition/processing source.
Copied cache and pinned Wiki snapshots are dated evidence, not a live game-client or server guarantee.
Missing or unresolved names keep an explicit unknown classification.
